name: WhileLoop
formula: =LAMBDA(currentParams,conditionFunc,nextValFunc,IF(conditionFunc(currentParams), currentParams, LET(nextParams, nextValFunc(currentParams), WhileLoop(nextParams, conditionFunc, nextValFunc))))
comment: While Loop. Logic: While 'conditionFunc(currentValue) = true, return currentValue; Else, run 'nextValFunc(currentValue,nextValFuncParams)' to get the update value until the condition is satisfied. Last Update at 2025-08-01.
